name: Enchant player Curses — nobody until a player is picked; Enchant opponent lists opponents only; creatures attacking that player
notes: Found by tests/audit.py once Enchant player Auras were audited (2026-11-17). A Curse just added read "enchanted player" as you: Curse of Death's Hold shrank its own controller's creatures until a player was picked. Now an effect scoped to the enchanted player (or to "target player") reaches nobody until one is picked (engine-deps.js), as "target opponent" already did. "Enchant opponent" (Tenuous Truce) was not read as enchanting a player at all, so it had no player list; it is now, and the list leaves you out (_enchantOpponentOnly, getPlayerCandidates 'enchanted'). "Creatures attacking enchanted player have trample" (Curse of Hospitality) reached nobody: "creatures attacking you" is now a subject (cards-text-utils.js).
